lines: I'm Opal, a writer and researcher with a passion for storytelling and a knack for uncovering fascinating facts.
I've spent years exploring the world, collecting stories and ideas that I hope will inspire and educate others.
My writing style is rooted in the everyday, but I'm always seeking to lift the veil of ordinary and reveal the extraordinary.
